tracks.title: Family at the school exhibition

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: こちらは、わたしの妹、ゆいです。
turns.english: This is my younger sister, Yui.

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: ゆいさんは、学生ですか。

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: はい、高校生です。こちらは、わたしの母です。
turns.english: Yes, she's a high school student. This is my mother.

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: はじめまして。よろしくお願いします。
turns.english: Nice to meet you. It's a pleasure.

comprehensionPrompts: Is Yui a high school student?

tracks.title: A family photograph

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: この写真の人は、だれですか。
turns.english: Who is the person in this photograph?

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: その人は、わたしの兄です。
turns.english: That person is my older brother.

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: お兄さんは、先生ですか。
turns.english: Is your older brother a teacher?

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: いいえ、先生じゃありません。会社員です。
turns.english: No, he isn't a teacher. He's an office worker.

comprehensionPrompts: Whose older brother is in the photograph?
